children: IBM, the hybrid cloud and mainframe company, brought a z17 system to Marist University's new Innovation Incubator. IBM
shares rose about 0.4% to $227.97 at 11.19am ET time on Friday. The stock stood 6.14% below its $242.88 GF Value estimate, though that gap says little about the payoff from this particular project.

The partners have worked together for more than 50 years. Now students and faculty can use the system to explore AI marketing agents, portfolio allocation and polling methods. These are proposed research projects, with no disclosed project budgets or financial targets.

For investors, the distinction is simple: a mainframe on campus is not proof of a new commercial sales stream. IBM gets its technology into the hands of people who may build on it or recommend it later. That could pay off, but the case grows stronger when research turns into software, customers or measurable demand.

title: IBM Stock Gains as z17 Enters an AI Classroom
